## reference · sharetribe transaction process state machine marketplace transitions
* Transaction process has multiple states and transitions
* Privileged transitions are available for certain transactions
* Transaction process can be customized using the Sharetribe Web Template
* Transaction fields can be added or edited using the Sharetribe CLI
* Payment methods and pricing can be customized for transactions
* Reviews and negotiation processes are part of the transaction process
* Transaction process can be integrated with third-party payment gateways
* Email notifications can be set up for transactions
* Transaction process can be tested and debugged using the Sharetribe CLI
* Transaction data can be extended using extended data
* Transaction process actions and format are referenced in the Sharetribe documentation
Sources: https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/concepts/transaction-process/
